question.text: PMS performance fee includes all EXCEPT:

answer.text: Performance fee with hurdle rate (no catch-up)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Upfront performance fee is PROHIBITED — performance fees are only payable on crystallised, HWM-cleared profits. **The Trap:** HWM/hurdle structures are allowed; upfront charges are not. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-A Topic 10. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Never invoice performance fees upfront — refund immediately if mistakenly collected.
